title: Host phase state spaces
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$, assign a state space to each host phase as follows: setup uses the cleaned-state space for $M_P$ together with a unit state; origin uses a rewind state paired with a Boolean, or a unit state; counter uses the sweep phases; zero uses the flag phases; rewind uses a rewind state or a unit state; loop uses the counter-loop states over the body states; and last uses the test states. Each answer phase uses a two-element state space.
